instruction: Candid documentary photograph, low-angle medium shot. In a judo dojo, the woman in the blue judo gi (R1) on the left and the young man in the white judo gi (R2) on the right kneel side-by-side on a blue and yellow mat. Both are bowing deeply forward with their heads lowered and hands flat on the mat. On the far left, a cropped leg of a bystander is partially visible. Soft indoor lighting illuminates the scene against a beige wall.
